comment:
* Common base class for preferences that have two selectable states, persist a
 * boolean value in SharedPreferences, and may have dependent preferences that are
 * enabled/disabled based on the current state.

methods.name: public void setChecked(boolean checked)
methods.comment:
* Sets the checked state and saves it to the {@link android.content.SharedPreferences}.
     *
     * @param checked The checked state.

methods.name: public boolean isChecked()
methods.comment:
* Returns the checked state.
     *
     * @return The checked state.

methods.name: public void setSummaryOn(CharSequence summary)
methods.comment:
* Sets the summary to be shown when checked.
     *
     * @param summary The summary to be shown when checked.

methods.name: public void setSummaryOn(int summaryResId)
methods.comment:
* @see #setSummaryOn(CharSequence)
     * @param summaryResId The summary as a resource.

methods.name: public CharSequence getSummaryOn()
methods.comment:
* Returns the summary to be shown when checked.
     * @return The summary.

methods.name: public void setSummaryOff(CharSequence summary)
methods.comment:
* Sets the summary to be shown when unchecked.
     *
     * @param summary The summary to be shown when unchecked.

methods.name: public void setSummaryOff(int summaryResId)
methods.comment:
* @see #setSummaryOff(CharSequence)
     * @param summaryResId The summary as a resource.

methods.name: public CharSequence getSummaryOff()
methods.comment:
* Returns the summary to be shown when unchecked.
     * @return The summary.

methods.name: public boolean getDisableDependentsState()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether dependents are disabled when this preference is on ({@code true})
     * or when this preference is off ({@code false}).
     *
     * @return Whether dependents are disabled when this preference is on ({@code true})
     *         or when this preference is off ({@code false}).

methods.name: public void setDisableDependentsState(boolean disableDependentsState)
methods.comment:
* Sets whether dependents are disabled when this preference is on ({@code true})
     * or when this preference is off ({@code false}).
     *
     * @param disableDependentsState The preference state that should disable dependents.

methods.name: protected Object onGetDefaultValue(TypedArray a, int index)
protected void onSetInitialValue(boolean restoreValue, Object defaultValue)
protected void syncSummaryView(PreferenceViewHolder holder)
methods.comment:
* Sync a summary holder contained within holder's subhierarchy with the correct summary text.
     * @param holder PreferenceViewHolder which holds a reference to the summary view

protected void onSetInitialValue(boolean restoreValue, Object defaultValue)
